scope: Actual loopback HTTP and disposable PGlite PostgreSQL anon RLS/RPC verification. Local HTTP bridge emulates only the fixed PostgREST read/RPC wire contract; this is not hosted Supabase, actual PostgREST, Vapi, Twilio, a call, or delivery evidence.

real HTTP callback reads actual anon approved local PostgreSQL row

real HTTP callback reads actual eligible sponsor RPC
unauthenticated real HTTP callback denied before database
invalid ten-digit ZIP returns correlated error without database

actual2500ms abort produces internal HTTP504 at harness adapter boundary
actual2500ms sponsor abort is translated to HTTP200 Vapi error
both delayed RPC HTTP connections actually aborted
normal real HTTP read recovers after controlled fault
